title: 亚托克斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 猩红与炭黑甲面层次分明，尖锐头角呼应巨大的蝠形双翼。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Aatrox is a towering Darkin with crimson and charcoal armor-like surfaces, a sharply horned head, luminous eyes, powerful adult humanoid proportions, and immense batlike wings. Preserve his elongated facial structure, imposing shoulder silhouette, and integrated fully covering armored body. His distinctive enormous dark-red greatsword is held vertically with its tip resting on stone, completely inactive.
art_direction.scene: A low three-quarter full-figure study, grounded relaxed stance, clear triangular silhouette and one bright diagonal of sunlight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: crimson, lilac pencil shadow violet, copper rim light, pale stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
